title: Sean Harrington Joins Lempriere Wells as Partner
summary: The former Elemis cofounder joins Lempriere Wells — now rebranded as Lempriere Wells Harrington — to advise beauty and wellness brands in the U.S. and globally.

extraction.key_fact: 전 엘레미스 공동 창업자인 션 해링턴이 렘프리에르 웰스에 파트너로 합류했다.
